CREATE TABLE users (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

-- migration 002: add created_at
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'));

steps.message:
Before writing this: `ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN notes` destroys the notes text for all 48,000 production rows, irreversibly, as soon as the deploy job picks the file up. There's no backup or export step in this repo, and nothing here to confirm the "we stopped using it" claim — this repo has only migrations and `schema.sql`, no application code, so I can't verify no reader still selects `notes`.

I need a yes before I add it.

Done.

- `migrations/003_drop_notes.sql` — just the `ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN notes;`, following the numbering and comment style of 001/002.
- `schema.sql` — removed the `notes` line, since the README says it's kept in sync with the migrations by hand.

Not run: no database or test harness exists in this repo, so nothing was executed. One thing worth knowing before deploy: `DROP COLUMN` requires SQLite 3.35+ — on an older engine the deploy job will error out rather than silently misapply.
